The reference explicitly states the chart illustrates 'staatlichen Ausgaben als Prozentsatz des Bruttoinlandsprodukts (BIP)', which is more general than 'Verteidigungsausgaben'. The machine-generated description narrows it incorrectly to defense spending.
The reference mentions the x-axis scale intervals of 0.5, but the machine-generated description only mentions intervals of 1.

The reference describes a 'schwarze Linie' (black line) at 1.5% above the 2021 reference value, but the machine-generated description incorrectly describes it as a 'vertikale gestrichelte Linie' (vertical dashed line).
